title: Card/Persona version history entirely undocumented
reality: Character and Persona cards have a full version-history system, refined across both releases. v2.3.5 (#4040): restoring an older version first saves the CURRENT card to history so the newer version is never lost; each saved version keeps its own edit timestamp rather than the later save's time; side-by-side comparison wraps long unbroken text (URLs, HTML in creator notes) instead of overflowing. v2.4.0 (#4040): the LIVE card is included as the first, explicitly labelled current revision, and saved revisions show stable sequence numbers with second-precision edit times. references/character-cards.md has no match for 'revision' or 'version history' at all.
fix: Add a 'Version history' subsection to references/character-cards.md. Directly relevant to ideation: it is the safety net that makes iterating on a card low-risk, and it is the correct answer to 'what if the Card Evolution Auditor makes a change I don't like'.

title: Markdown preview toggles on card/persona/lorebook fields missing
reality: v2.4.0 (#4306) added Markdown preview toggles to Character, Persona, AND lorebook text fields, and rendered formatted card text in library detail views.
fix: Add to references/character-cards.md (and note the lorebook field coverage in references/lorebooks.md). Practical for authoring advice: users can now verify markdown formatting in the editor rather than round-tripping through a chat to see how it renders.

title: Character name whitespace trimming on save/import not noted
reality: v2.4.0 (#4303) trims leading and trailing whitespace from Character names when cards are saved or imported.
fix: Add a one-line note to references/character-cards.md. Low severity, but it is the explanation for a class of previously-baffling bugs where a trailing space broke name matching, macro substitution, or group-speaker prefixes.

title: Character Tavern / zTXt compressed card parsing missing
reality: v2.3.5 (#4002) fixed Character Tavern imports from the Card Browser: those cards store character data in COMPRESSED zTXt PNG chunks, which every Marinara card parser (Card Browser import, file/URL import, SillyTavern bulk import) now reads alongside tEXt and iTXt. Re-exporting such a character also strips the stale compressed data instead of shipping outdated card JSON.
fix: Add to the PNG card-import material in references/character-cards.md. Concretely useful: it names the three chunk types Marinara reads and explains why a re-exported Character Tavern card used to carry stale JSON.

title: Set as avatar from Gallery missing
reality: v2.3.5 (#3974) added 'Set as avatar' to Character and Persona Gallery images in both the grid and full-size viewer, using path-contained, image-validated server copies. v2.3.5 also reworked avatar editing with a non-overlapping miniature AI wand and equal Upload/Generate actions in Metadata.
fix: Add to references/character-cards.md's avatar material. It closes the loop between the Illustrator/Gallery pipeline and the card's identity image, which the references currently treat as unrelated surfaces.

title: Game Mode character-sheet Retry not documented
reality: v2.4.0 (#4048) added a Retry action to Game Mode character-sheet editing: it regenerates only the selected Persona or party member from their card and the current campaign history, keeps the result as an UNSAVED DRAFT for review, and preserves the original sheet unless the user saves.
fix: Add to the Game Mode material in references/architecture.md and cross-reference from character-cards.md. The draft-unless-saved semantics match the schedule-import and card-version patterns — worth noting as a consistent engine convention rather than three isolated behaviors.
